# EasyOpen Security Policy

## Scope

This policy currently covers EasyOpen code under `easyopen/`, including the public website, desktop and mobile apps, account API, container manifests, release workflows, and update metadata.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability, credential, private server address, user data, or reproduction secret in a public issue.

Use GitHub's private **Report a vulnerability** form for this repository:

<https://github.com/ParkSuJeong74/my_own_note/security/advisories/new>

Include the affected component and version, impact, safe reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. Remove real credentials and personal data from screenshots and logs.

If the private form is unavailable, open a public issue containing only the title `Private security contact requested`. Do not include vulnerability details. Ordinary broken links, incorrect support labels, and non-sensitive UI bugs may use the public issue tracker.

## Response and disclosure

Receipt, severity, remediation, release, and disclosure timing are handled separately. A report is not considered fixed until the affected release path and regression tests have been verified.
